title: Moula Ali hits 14.1°C; hazy mornings till Nov 17

slides.head: Moula Ali hits 14.1°C; hazy mornings till Nov 17
What happened
slides.body: Moula Ali recorded 14.1°C, followed by BHEL and HCU Serilingampally at 14.6°C and Rajendranagar at 14.8°C.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Winter chill has set in across Telangana; independent forecaster T Balaji (Telangana Weatherman) expects it to ease after November 20 with rain linked to Cyclone Akvan.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Kohir in Sangareddy recorded 11°C, with Sirpur at 11.2°C and Gandhari at 11.5°C.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether IMD issues a rain alert for Telangana as Cyclone Akvan develops after November 20. Ask: Will Cyclone Akvan's rain reach Hyderabad or stay in other districts?

Moula Ali hits 14.1°C; hazy mornings till Nov 17

IMD Hyderabad has forecast mist and haze in the mornings till November 17, with partly cloudy skies, but no cold-wave or rain warning.

Why it matters: Winter chill has set in across Telangana; independent forecaster T Balaji (Telangana Weatherman) expects it to ease after November 20 with rain linked to Cyclone Akvan.

Source: Siasat. Image: Siasat
